clauses.why: Only 7:10 states the deed; 7:11-12 are about the magicians and the rods.

clauses.ukr: кинув свою палицю перед фараоном, і вона стала вужем
clauses.deu: warf seinen Stab vor Pharao, und er wurde zur Schlange
clauses.spa: echó su vara delante de Faraón, y se volvió culebra

answer.note: The line omits Aaron's appointment as high priest and the making of the priesthood, which is more important than some clauses given.
